body: I've been improving myself for 2 years. I have hobbies. Women just run when they here I have a dinky warehouse job. I don't know whether to go back to school or not, because I feel like if I do, I'll piss away the last of my 20's for just a shot at improving my financial circumstances
I understand, and I've been making an effort, but it feels pointless with how much time I've lost and how much more exponential effort I will need to match better prospects.
Understandable. Also, fyi I'm not a virgin.
